en.headline: Cine Fan Summer International Film Festival opens with Na Hong-jin’s HOPE
en.dek: The Hong Kong International Film Festival Society’s summer programme runs until 31 August, opening with the South Korean director’s Cannes competition title and featuring a masterclass.
body: The Cine Fan Summer International Film Festival opened on Wednesday with screenings of South Korean director Na Hong-jin’s science-fiction thriller HOPE, the title that competed in the main competition at Cannes.

Organised by the Hong Kong International Film Festival Society, the festival runs until 31 August at venues including PREMIERE Elements, the Hong Kong Arts Centre Louis Koo Cinema and EMP Cinemas. Na is scheduled to meet audiences and conduct a masterclass during the run.

The closing film on 30 August is the local production The Paper Box Mystery, produced by Philip Yung and directed by Tam Kwong-yuen, which draws on a 1970s Hong Kong case. Other programmes include a 4K restoration of Wong Kar-wai’s Days of Being Wild and a focus on early works by Hong Sang-soo.

Tickets are available through URBTIX. Full-time local students, people aged 60 or above, persons with disabilities and their carers, and Comprehensive Social Security Assistance recipients may purchase tickets at a reduced price of HK$28 per screening.

zh.headline: 夏日國際電影節開幕 羅泓軫《HOPE：逆襲希望港》打頭陣
zh.dek: 香港國際電影節協會主辦的夏日影展即日至8月31日舉行，開幕電影為康城主競賽作品，導演將來港主持大師班。
body: Cine Fan夏日國際電影節周三開幕，以南韓導演羅泓軫的科幻懸疑驚慄片《HOPE：逆襲希望港》打頭陣。該片曾入選康城影展主競賽單元。
影展由香港國際電影節協會主辦，即日至8月31日於PREMIERE Elements、香港藝術中心古天樂電影院及EMP戲院等場地舉行。羅泓軫將於影展期間與觀眾會面並主持大師班。
閉幕電影為8月30日的本地製作《紙盒藏迷》，由翁子光監製、譚廣源執導，改編自1970年代本港案件。其他節目包括王家衛《阿飛正傳》4K修復版，以及洪常秀早期作品專題。
門票於城市售票網發售。本地全日制學生、60歲或以上長者、殘疾人士及其看護人，以及綜援受惠人士可享每場28元優惠。
